description: This file contains unit tests for web server and client interactions within the WPEFramework, utilizing Google Test framework. It defines WebServer and WebClient classes that simulate server and client behavior, testing HTTP GET request/response handling over WebSocket streams.

classes.name: WebServer
classes.description: A mock web server class that handles incoming Web::Request objects, verifies request details, and sends back a Web::Response with status 200.

classes.name: WebClient
classes.description: A mock web client class that sends Web::Request objects, receives Web::Response, and verifies response details, including message content.

methods.name: LinkBody
methods.description: Attaches a Web::TextBody to the request or response.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Handles incoming requests or responses, performs validation, and processes the data.

methods.name: Retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves the received data from the WebClient.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits for data to be received.
